notes.title: The Zebra-Man! is now better than ever!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33243736/5ecb2a051197bfafe4f693a6f6230aba5cb5fc02.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone! 

Hope you are having a fantastic week! Because it's about to get better. We've brought you an update for The Zebra-Man game! It is version 2.5.3. 

In this new version we fixed minor issues, such as the lighting of the 3D levels, removed the constant pop-up every time you eliminated an enemy and solved the problem of undefined NPC pushing. 

Below you have the Patch Note of [b]version 2.5.3[/b]: 

[list]
[*] Constant Stat Update (NPCs killed) now only shows when Achievement is Unlocked
[*] Added linear damp to npcs so they are not pushed indefinitely
[*] Remade the lighting batch of 3D levels
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055360/The_ZebraMan/

notes.title: From the people who brought you Metal Tales Overkill, now comes The Zebra-Man! Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/591d3453840b2054cc41e872ed7fafbca3787b15.jpg[/img]
Zerouno Games brings you their next adventure in a top-down action slasher with...  

https://youtu.be/4Ef2HiyDdPI

At [b]Zerouno Games[/b] we are once again super scared to present you our next game: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zerounogames/the-zebra-man-0]The Zebra-Man![/url] It's a top-down action game with blood (a little too much) and a retro finish. But don't be scared, the story and mechanics are anything but retro. Will you join us?  


Next [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zerounogames/the-zebra-man-0]February 21st[/url] we will launch our new Kickstarter funding campaign. With it we intend to release, what we consider, a game full of humor, action, unexpected plot twists, stealth and blood. Lots of blood.  

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/d2503a86ffb7ed6ccb9da8816da69998bbc352c4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/648adb39e2a393b8b185bd07b781ccc0099ad451.jpg[/img]

Here you have a little bit of information about the game.  

--- 

[i]The Zebra-Man! is a hyper-charged action game with brutal fist fights and blood spilling in your wake. 

Trapped in a secret facility at an undetermined time, you are a man without an identity. Confused and lost, you receive help from the mysterious Raccoon. He is determined that you kill Alexander Cooper and will only release you if you agree. Soon you're caught up intime travel, interdimensional portals and enemies who just want to see you torn into a million little pieces. [/i]

Story: 

[i]It's the early 70's, and some mad scientists have been doing nasty stuff to you for quite long. Somehow, a random cosplay guy with a gas mask gets into the lab you're being kept and offers himself to help you out. 

After many traumas and engrams triggered by the experiments that took place on your body, getting rid of your humanity and sticking to your spirit animal may be your only way out. When a light ray is born in the darkness of despair, it's kill or be killed. [/i]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/edf37854223f55021179656f99ddbe0153effaaa.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [i]Kill Count. You'll see before the end of each level how many enemies you defeated. 
[*] Puzzles. Not the kind that gets you stuck! (Hopefully...) 
[*] Secrets and Easter Eggs in every single level. We want to encourage players to explore! 
[*] Adaptive Difficulty. The more times you die, the easier the level gets. Enemies turn slower, those with guns have less ammo, and more helpful items spawn. [/i]
[/list]

--- 

If you were a backer of the Metal Tales Overkill game, you must have been aware of certain problems: delays in porting, shipping... That's over! The price (of not knowing how everything that comes after the KS campaign works) has already been paid. Anybody teach you in school how to manage all the things you have to do. You learn it the hard way. And that's so true that it hurts to learn it.   

Starting today, you can [b]help us get to the finish line[/b]. You can add the game right now to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055360/The_ZebraMan/]your Steam wishlist[/url], you can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zerounogames/the-zebra-man-0]ask Kickstarter to let you know when the campaign goes live[/url], or you can also follow us on our social networks [url=https://twitter.com/zerounogames]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.instagram.com/zerounogames/]Instagram[/url] to know what's going on day by day.

notes.title: Play Metal Tales Overkill now on Steamdeck
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/58974ad5e142939d89d3abe5f173db481f99cd00.png[/img]

Global games developer and publisher Zerouno Games is thrilled to announce that following a hugely successful Kickstarter campaign, their rock music inspired rogue-like 3D Shooter Metal Tales: Overkill [b]is available out today digitally for Steamdeck[/b].

Since being funded within 8 hours on Kickstarter, the team at Zerouno Games has been cranking up the heat and rocking the development of  Metal Tales: Overkill, the ultimate action-adventure game where Metal and Adrenaline collide to create the ultimate 3D rogue-like guitar-shooter. Get ready to fight through procedurally generated levels and battle against a terrible looming curse affecting your metal brothers. Do you have what it takes to  free them from this ancient evil and secure your place as the ultimate Rock God?

[previewyoutube=KY82jAGenYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About Metal Tales: Overkill [/b]

Metal Tales: Overkill is an action-adventure game where Metal and Adrenaline collide to deliver the ultimate rogue-like 3D guitar shooter. Fight against the looming curse affecting your Metal brothers and free them from an ancient evil. 

The God Kuk is possessing all the guitar gods, and through them, the metalheads. Through infinite concerts, he is helping his legion of metalhead zombies wipe out every original creation of metal bands and their dedicated fans. As legions of metalheads are stripped from their passion, only one person can really grind through the challenge and come out victorious. 

Choose your path carefully through the procedurally generated levels and battle the evil hordes looking to destroy you at every turn. As each playthrough will be different, grab your guitar, don your ripped jeans and dive right back into the intense action one more time.  

[b]Features[/b] 

[list]
[*] 50+ items - Charge up with new guitars, strings, pedals, amps, books, and summons. 
[*] 15 different enemies -  to beat to the beat. 
[*] 8 Guitar Bosses - Go toe to toe in the ultimate Rock showdown! 
[*] 4 playable characters -  Are you more Metallica, Iron Maiden or Black Sabbath? Choose the character you identify with the most and Rock on!  
[*] 3 intense environments: Exploring 3 different environments - the Metal Den, Metal Festival and the ultimate performance stage . . .  Hell itself!  
[*] 6 levels - Blast through 6 different levels with unstoppable Rock guitar energy. 
[*] Procedurally generated levels - Experience randomly generated levels to play through. No play session will ever be the same. 
[*] Local CO-OP - Jump in and jam it out with a friend. 
[*] Mission system - Unlock new abilities and upgrade stats between runs. 
[*] Original soundtrack and international Metal bands’ songs - Rock out to an awesome soundtrack. You’re sure to find a new hidden metal gem!  
[/list]

Metal Tales: Overkill is now available digitally for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 4 & 5.  

For more information visit the [url=https://zerounogames.com/metal-tales-overkill/]official website here[/url].  

Follow Zerouno Games on social media at [url=https://twitter.com/zerounogames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/zerounogames/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNrbXL2dyFUvZBotsAi321A]YouTube[/url], [url=https://discord.com/invite/h9AAFJZ]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ZerounoGames01/]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Hell of Men: Blood Brothers - New factions!
notes.content:
Hello to all,  

Today, you will discover in this article, the new faction that will be available in v1.  The Baltic Countries are coming in Hell of Men: Blood Brothers! 
The Baltic Countries are represented by 3 skins in the game. Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4630a5d1170237b4502e4a83035730ca4609eb16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/340d992c4a52b3284b2fc0e2579599b5b803f9b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4e38f8ae854f95e9249f124932b3197cbc044c5a.png[/img]

[u][b]Building:[/b][/u]
The buildings have a "container" style, we find the same as for the other factions except for the infirmary which disappears.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/62bd125ede5892b77a665a2c1cd8d04b0cc42591.png[/img]

The specificity of the tent is its low cost which can give an advantage at the beginning of the game, however it offers only 3 additional population slots. You will have to build more tents than the other factions to reach the maximum of 40 units.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8a7b2ed6926d01a888698d3305a1481fa6a90e0d.png[/img]

[u][b]Unit:[/b][/u]
[u]Barracks:[/u] 
[list]
[*] Rifleman = Germany/Russia.  
[*] Grenade launcher = all factions.  
[*] Rocket launcher = Poland/Russia.  
[*] Fusion launcher = all factions.  
[*] Operator = Poland/Belarus.  
[*] Machine gunner/Mastodon = + 1 damage / 0.1 rate of fire reduction.  
[*] Sniper/Sniper guillie = - 5 damage / increase rate of fire by +2.  
[/list]

[u]Communication Center:[/u]
[list]
[*] Sapper = Russia - short range.  
[*] Tank crew = Poland/Russia/Belarus.  
[*] Mortar = - 1 damage / increase movement speed by +0.3. 
[/list]

[u]Laboratory:[/u]
[list]
[*] UAV = all factions.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-infantry combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-tank combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Healing Drone.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/af5cd58a9dc3bf64e5e048ab23f866e6fee12f21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/019fc0b235d69e476159dc278b8e04fa41cf1b02.png[/img]

The anti-infantry combat drone is inspired by the Estonian Milsem drone with its anti-vehicle variant. It has the same attack stats as the Russian drone with a higher hit point count and reduced speed. Its anti-tank variant joins the French anti-tank drone but uses rockets.  

The healing drone is a flying drone with the ability to heal infantry units.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/16eb4b90e466eb160bdd1b08bcbd9c863b5094f0.png[/img]
 

[u]Vehicle:[/u]  
The Buggy is equal to the other factions with only 3 seats.  
The Jeep is equipped with a grenade launcher and reduced armor –20 health points.  
The Truck is equal to the German faction and unarmed.  
The Armored Support is equal to that of the Polish faction.  
The Light Tank is equal to that of the Polish faction with reinforced armor giving it +50 health points.  
The Tank is equal to the other factions with a reinforced armor giving it +50 health points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/25cc80b355912943fde0a799a5cd71872f49d713.png[/img]

notes.title: Epic Science-Fiction's inner search meets 3D shooter with Green Phoenix
notes.content:
[img]https://db3pap005files.storage.live.com/y4m8f3Xpy1ZZduN4jU0AIxMGikUG9km8V2bBjFAX-xs9sihEH0k1AAcaeHtyB-kGvP4scQcZwEQohbrKb8brxA4VQtISb9lR0nFer2IgxMyCsOxvFd7b_SIZw_sPNzAJ58LQfFPFl05hgAfMaM1Fm8BKk7Sav0lcLEySXpchFdFAoqF3T5KvmohNMZxJiIaU6l5?width=750&height=100&cropmode=none[/img]

[url=https://zerounogames.com/]Zerouno Games[/url] presents the latest audiovisual experience created by the Spanish studio Broken Simulation, [url=https://zerounogames.com/our-games/green-phoenix/][i]Green Phoenix[/i][/url]. 

[previewyoutube=HsjdkOVbR7k;full][/previewyoutube]

With this [b]intimate and personal story[/b] we approach a four-chapter narrative game in which we explore the emergence of the ego in artificial intelligence. 

[b]The title will be released on Thursday, May 27 on Steam and Nintendo Switch platforms at a price of 2.99€. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584770/Green_Phoenix/

[b]Green Phoenix [/b]

[i]Green Phoenix[/i] is an on-rails 3D space shooter mixed with a deep narrative experience that focuses on the concept of ego and the meaning of freedom. 
 
In [i]Green Phoenix[/i], we are transported to a single player story where society is fully technologized and authoritarian and take us on the role of the spaceship AI, Green Phoenix, as it remembers its dead pilot, Dana, and embarks on a journey of revenge. 

[b]Features [/b]

[list]
[*] Deep and inmersive storytelling 
[*] Beautifully sculpted worlds 
[*] Fully voiced 
[*] Arcade mode, how long will you survive? 
[/list]

notes.title: DEFENTRON, the final 80s Tower Defense is already available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157335/88a1afceaf9dad30fe7bf90bef6b7c203f8e7e57.jpg[/img]

[url=https://zerounogames.com/our-games/defentron/]DEFENTRON[/url], developed by the portuguese [url=https://planetfall.studio/]Planetfall Studios[/url] and published by [url=https://zerounogames.com/]Zerouno Games[/url], is a tower defense game that will be launched today on Steam at a [b]price of 9,99€ / 9,99$ / 8,99 GBP[/b]. 

Get ready and battle for the ultimate upgrade. Defentron, the retro-futurist computer system is trying to safeguard itself from malicious viruses that seek to control its core.  

Use strategy to upgrade your lines of defense and become the most powerful security system ever known.   

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] 3D tower defense game
[*] 80’s-like visuals
[*] Use different strategies to upgrade your lines of defense
[*] Become the most powerful security system ever known
[*] Face fast, hard, resilient enemies, capable of regenerating or splitting when destroyed
[*] The levels finish when the last of the living enemies falls
[/list]

If you like the game, don't hesitate to [b]add this game to your wishlist[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475970/Defentron/
